summary: INT. THUNDERBREAK — COMMAND — DAY. COMMODORE VENN studies Calm Corridor projections.

dialogueInline.text: Geometry holds. Corridor stable, no flux.

dialogueInline.text: Nothing stays calm forever. (to Stormwell) How do you archive something that isn’t real?

dialogueInline.speaker: Archivist Selen Stormwell
dialogueInline.text: We archive what it does to us.
